dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: I hope you're right! While there's always something unpleasant to deal with, as we say in Fontaine, "that's life."

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Don't you think so, dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: You see? Luca's wit is as electrifying as ever. I'm overjoyed to hear him answer your question so concisely.
